meta.name: ccs-align
meta.description: Run the CCS Align seat's hourly breathing cycle — prove the local claude-mem worker is healthy, pull needle observations through search → timeline → get_observations, land them in a seat-owned middle cache via atomic grab → append → filter exclude-marks → replace, manage exclude marks, and walk house → project → seat rules to detect conflicts (SHADOW_HOUSE, DENY_ALLOW, DRIFT, CLOCK_HEADER) with an append-only rules-report.md. Use when asked to run CCS Align, breathe the alignment seat, refresh the middle cache, exclude or restore an observation, walk rules, check rules conflicts, or check the Worker Watch board.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动巡检并维护AI记忆服务,同时发现规则冲突报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你管理本地AI记忆服务,希望每小时自动检查并整理它。
copy.tagline_en: Run hourly checks on AI memory, refresh its cache, and catch rule conflicts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a local AI memory service and want its cache and rules checked hourly.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会执行“CCS Align”对齐循环:先确认本地记忆工作进程在线,再调取指定的观察记录,写入它自己维护的中间缓存;可把某条观察标记为“排除”以移出缓存,也可恢复;每隔数轮会检查规则文件的冲突并追加到报告。平时静默,出错才和你说话。
howto.when: 当你说出“要求运行 CCS Align”、“刷新中间缓存”、“把某条观察排除或恢复”等话术时触发;本地记忆工作进程若不运行,它会中止并记录一次失败。

say.text: 运行 CCS Align 呼吸循环。
say.note: 触发健康检查、拉取观察并写入中间缓存。

say.text: 把观察 12345 标记为排除。
say.note: 该观察会从对齐用的中间缓存移除;原始日记仍保留。

say.text: 检查一下 CCS Align 的规则冲突。
say.note: 它会走查各层规则并追加到规则报告文件。

howto.what_en: On request, Claude runs a cycle: checks worker health, pulls observations, writes them to a seat-owned cache, applies exclude marks, and every 6th run walks rules and appends a report. It stays quiet unless something fails.
howto.when_en: When asked to run CCS Align, refresh the middle cache, or exclude/restore an observation; if the local worker is down it aborts and records a miss.

say_en.text: Run the CCS Align breathing cycle.
say_en.note: Triggers health check, fetch, and cache write.
Removes it from the seat cache; the diary stays.
Walks rule layers and appends the report.
